command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
git fetch origin main work/content-encodings --no-tags --prune
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "fetch failed" }
if ((git rev-parse origin/main).Trim() -ne "3c271accc127e8ff6a4cc120d6c055d7bc97bece") { throw "main moved" }
if ((git rev-parse origin/work/content-encodings).Trim() -ne "bdb40c98fc1d40cae02300cc0ad2d3ee149b0212") { throw "candidate moved" }
if ((git status --short).Count -ne 0) { throw "dirty persistent checkout" }

$evidence="C:\dev\flyExplorer\logs\remote-evidence"
if (Test-Path $evidence) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $evidence }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $evidence | Out-Null
@'
from pathlib import Path
import ctypes as c, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
from ctypes import wintypes as W
from PIL import ImageGrab
from pywinauto import Desktop

root=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
exe=root/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
out=Path(sys.argv[1])
after=len(sys.argv)>2 and sys.argv[2]=="after"
owned=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="encoding-visual-",dir=root/"logs"))
folder=owned/"인코딩시각"; folder.mkdir()
(folder/"sample.txt").write_text("owned content visual",encoding="utf-8")
appdata=owned/"appdata"; localdata=owned/"localdata"; tmp=owned/"tmp"
for p in (appdata,localdata,tmp): p.mkdir()
profile=localdata/"flyExplorer"; profile.mkdir()
(profile/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_bytes(
    b"schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=details\r\n")
env={**os.environ,"APPDATA":str(appdata),"LOCALAPPDATA":str(localdata),
     "TEMP":str(tmp),"TMP":str(tmp)}
u=c.windll.user32
CALL=c.WINFUNCTYPE(W.BOOL,W.HWND,W.LPARAM)
def hwnds(pid):
    out=[]
    @CALL
    def cb(h,_):
        owner=W.DWORD();u.GetWindowThreadProcessId(h,c.byref(owner))
        if owner.value==pid and u.IsWindowVisible(h):out.append(int(h))
        return 1
    u.EnumWindows(cb,0);return out
def wait(fn,label,timeout=15):
    end=time.monotonic()+timeout
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        try:
            if fn():return
        except Exception:pass
        time.sleep(.15)
    raise AssertionError(label)
p=subprocess.Popen([str(exe),str(folder)],cwd=exe.parent,env=env,
    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
try:
    wait(lambda:bool(hwnds(p.pid)) or p.poll() is not None,"window missing")
    assert p.poll() is None,p.returncode
    hwnd=hwnds(p.pid)[0]
    assert u.SetWindowPos(hwnd,0,80,40,956,689,0x0040)
    win=Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=hwnd)
    wait(lambda:win.child_window(auto_id="SearchPanelButton").exists(timeout=.2),
         "search button missing")
    win.set_focus();win.child_window(auto_id="SearchPanelButton").click_input()
    wait(lambda:win.child_window(auto_id="SearchContentBox").exists(timeout=.2),
         "content search row missing")
    win.child_window(auto_id="SearchContentBox").set_edit_text("레거시한글")
    if after:
        enc=win.child_window(auto_id="SearchContentEncodingBox")
        wait(lambda:enc.exists(timeout=.2),"encoding selector missing")
        enc.select(1)
    rect=win.rectangle()
    assert (rect.width(),rect.height())==(956,689),(rect.width(),rect.height())
    ImageGrab.grab(bbox=(rect.left,rect.top,rect.right,rect.bottom),
                  include_layered_windows=True).save(out)
    print("CONTENT_ENCODING_VISUAL_SIZE",(rect.width(),rect.height()),flush=True)
finally:
    if p.poll() is None:
        hs=hwnds(p.pid)
        if hs:u.PostMessageW(hs[0],0x0010,0,0)
        try:p.wait(timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            p.kill();p.wait(timeout=5)
    shutil.rmtree(owned,ignore_errors=True)

'@ | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 "logs\capture-content-encoding-visual.py"
